items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: And now, I recommend to Benny -- I play trumpet for a guy. He used to call it Luis Garcia.

ctx.x: Yeah, '34, because we was working in the Casino de Paris. There was Ben Pollack and Chick, and Ben Pollack was playing -- Harry James play in there. (Unintelligible) was the drummer. Miller was the tenor. And Benny was getting his band together.
And now, I recommend to Benny -- I play trumpet for a guy. He used to call it Luis Garcia. Luis Garcia was a very popular popular trumpet player. He was with Whiteman for a while.
